title: What this group owes
lede: Every commitment a member has recorded, and the form that records one. Nothing here has moved yet: an obligation is a promise, and a settlement cycle is what turns promises into payments.
empty: Nothing matches this view yet. Record a commitment below, or widen the filters.

list.title: Commitments
list.description: Newest first. Amounts are what was promised, in the currency it was promised in.
list.caption: The group's recorded commitments

form.title: Record a commitment
form.description: Who owes whom, how much, and why. Recording one does not move money; the group's next settlement cycle is what does.
form.debtorHint: The member whose debt this is.
form.amountHint: In the currency's own precision - rupees take two decimals, yen take none.
form.settleInHint: Leave this alone unless the creditor is to be paid in another currency. That makes it a cross-currency commitment, and a rate is fixed when you record it.
form.indicativeRate: Indicative rate: 1 {base} is {rate} {quote}, quoted {quotedAt}. The rate that counts is fixed when you record this.
form.memoHint: What this was for, in the words of the members involved. It is stored exactly as written and never translated.
form.occurredAtHint: The group's cycle boundary decides which cycle a commitment falls into, so a commitment for last week belongs to last week.
form.notWorthRetrying: This was refused, and asking again would be refused the same way. Change what the message asks for and record it again.
